output.content: Just finished walking through the nightly ingestion logs with the team. We are currently running the data validation process entirely by hand. Every morning, I sit down with a spreadsheet and manually cross-reference the incoming batch files against the expected schema definitions. It takes about three hours of focused work to scan for null values and type mismatches in the raw data before it hits the staging area. There is no automated script checking these constraints yet. We simply eyeball the sample rows and flag any anomalies in a shared document for the downstream modelers to review later in the day.
